messages.content: Guys I finally caught a Charizard!! 🔥
You mean it finally stopped disobeying you?
Ha! Reminds me of my Onix days.
Cute. I have ten of them.
It's not about how many, Gary, it's about the bond!
Someone's gotta cook before this turns into a rivalry battle.
Speaking of bonds, mine nearly drowned you in Cerulean, remember?
That was ONE time and I was ten years old.
You're still basically ten years old.
Guys. Focus. Charizard. Big news. Let him have this.
Thank you Brock.
It still won't listen to me half the time though.
So basically no news then.
lmao
IT KNOWS FLAMETHROWER NOW OKAY
That's actually great, congrats Ash.
Fine, congrats. Don't let it go to your head.
Too late, his head's the size of a Snorlax already.
Says the guy with ten Charizards.
I never said ten Charizards. I said ten Pokémon total.
Oh. Okay well still.
Can we talk about literally anything else.
Brock's just mad none of us asked about his gym.
I'm not mad. I run a very successful Rock-type gym.
How's business.
...slow.
Have you tried NOT using Onix against Grass types.
One time. That happened one time.
It happened three times, I was there for two of them.
Traitor.
Anyway I'm heading to the Indigo Plateau next week.
Wait, seriously? Me too!
Of course you are.
Please don't let them room together, I'm begging.
Too late, I already booked it as a bit.
BROCK
BROCK
You're welcome.
I'm coming just to watch this unfold.
Fine. FINE. But no talking during my matches.
I make no promises.
Gary.
Ash.
I'm bringing snacks for the whole trip, don't worry about food.
This is the only reason I said yes.
Wow, love you too Misty.
I said it was the ONLY reason, keep up.
She's not wrong, Brock's cooking carried us through Viridian Forest.
It's the little things.
Okay but for real, are we all training this week or what?
I've been training since sunrise, unlike some people.
I was training! Pikachu and I ran laps around the lab.
Pikachu ran laps. You watched Pikachu run laps.
...that's still cardio for me emotionally.
I can't believe I'm going to be stuck refereeing this entire trip.
You love it, don't lie.
I do, but I'm allowed to complain too.
Fair enough. See everyone at the Plateau.
See you all there! Let's go!!
Try to lose with some dignity this time.
I'm not losing to ANYONE this time, Gary.
That's the spirit. Terrible odds, great spirit.
Ash, did you finish training for the Sinnoh League?
He's probably still stuck on type match-ups lol
Hey! I know Water beats Fire now!
...and Fire beats Grass, and Grass beats Water, right?
...right?
We have so much work to do.
Heard you lost to a Magikarp trainer in Kalos.
It evolved mid-battle, that's not really fair to leave out.
IT BECAME A GYARADOS, GARY.
Sure it did.
I filmed it, I can send proof.
